trajectory.content:
Implemented the performance fix in `solve.cu`:

- Removed the batch-wise launch/synchronization behavior that caused thousands of tiny GPU launches and device-wide syncs.
- Uses the supplied GPU KD-tree rather than an O(N×M) brute-force scan.
- Keeps all intermediate reduction data on device:
  - persistent lazily allocated scratch accumulator,
  - asynchronous stream-ordered resets,
  - no host-side centroid copy or `cudaStreamSynchronize` in the correspondence path.
